limits: Internal checks and small delegated Agent trials, not adoption or routing accuracy measurements.

All application data and recordings were fictional. Raw logs, recordings, client configuration and machine paths remain local.
Prompts below omit harness instructions and replace local inputs with placeholders. Delegated model identifiers were not exposed.
Visual inspection used sampled frames. Complete media decoding does not establish readability at every playback size.
